results.title: Dahlia has a Phobia
results.overview: Two women retreat for a quiet weekend to salvage their unraveling relationship. But when one’s crippling fear of scarecrows resurfaces, their fragile dynamic begins to fracture. As the scarecrow disappears—and reappears—the line between paranoia and reality erodes, and survival becomes uncertain.

results.title: I Was a Witness
results.overview: What begins as a quiet photography project turns into a harrowing journey into the depths of a parallel religious world. Photographer Andreas Reiner meets former members of the Jehovah’s Witnesses—people who had the courage to leave a strictly controlled religious community. In open, poignant conversations, they talk about their childhood and youth within the tight corset of religious rules, psychological pressure, sexualized violence, conversion therapy, and the existential rupture that came with leaving.

results.title: Il desiderio di essere inutile - Hugo a Venezia
results.original_title: Il desiderio di essere inutile - Hugo a Venezia
results.overview: The title 'The desire to be useless' recalls a famous Hugo Pratt's expression and contains a double meaning. On one hand, it representes the comic's claim as an art form, long considered  marginal but elevated, but by Pratt was considered a language with high literary and artistic value. On the other, it expresses a life philosophy founded on freedom, on the rejection of reducing existence to fiction or to commodity, and on the possibility of the adventure and the unexpected. Containing interviews with Patrizia Zanotti, Dominique Petitfaux, Thierry Thomas e Marco Steiner, the documentary completes a cinematic research lasted twenty years, returning Hugo Pratt as one of the most important auhor of illustrated literature and an artist still capable of being received by the contemporary audience.

results.title: Rebirth of the Living Dead
results.overview: Following the events of both "Night of The Living Dead" and "Return of The Living Dead", "Rebirth of The Living Dead" picks up nearly 50 years later in Los Angeles where "Trioxin Trash" is the new drug on the street. This "ultimate high" turns users into brain-craving Living Dead and it's up to a lone Scientist and a young couple to uncover the cure before it's too late.

results.title: Regina
results.overview: A fantastic biopic based on the life of actress and producer Regina Vogue, one of the leading figures in Brazilian theater. Today, at 81, she recounts her story. In a playful way, the film delves into various theatrical forms, such as shadow theater, puppet theater, and the use of masks. Thus, Regina reveals the resilient spirit of an artist in a delicate blend of reality and fiction, where everything is true.
